name: @szl/a11oy-code
description: A11oy Code — terminal-native, governed, self-evolving agentic coding tool. Absorbs the design ideas of Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Cline, Codex CLI, Devin, Continue, Sweep, Goose and OpenHands; extends them with thesis-grounded planning (Ouroboros), Lutar tool routing, multi-provider governed routing, a per-step proof ledger, and bounded autonomous self-evolution under MirrorEval with automatic rollback.
author: SZL Holdings
